headline: Mystical Space Typhoon
title: Mystical Space Typhoon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Mystical Space Typhoon. What is it? It is a Quick-Play Spell Card. What does it do? Target one Spell or Trap on the field and destroy it. How do you use it? Because it is a Quick-Play Spell, you can Set it and use it on your opponent's turn, for example on a Trap they just flipped up or on a Continuous Spell. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
